> > V7 is about error logging
> 
> @mastacheata Nooooo! How many requirements in V7 describe error handling? 3. So, V7 title is with wrong pressure or a bit misleading.

If you quote me, quote me completely:
> If you want to be nitpicking: V7 is about error logging

That's about the headline, which could trick people into thinking these requirements would only apply to error logging.
I have no idea how other people perform a security analysis or even an audit based on the ASVS.
My first and so far only contact with the ASVS or any security standard for that matter was my own master's thesis that I just completed last week.
